---
title: "Utah Ice Cream Shop Analysis Package"
---

## Overview

This project analyzes Yelp Ice Cream businesses in Utah County and Salt Lake County
to explore how **review volume**, **city**, **price** and **delivery** relate to **customer ratings**.

The package provides tools for:

- Cleaning Yelp API data
- Analyzing features
- Analyzing relationships between business characteristics and ratings
- Visualizing results

## Installation

```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/dmbinns/yelp_final_project.git
```
